title: One Team, One Goal
summary: Our Bedford, Massachusetts, team exceeded our Q3 revenue goals and what stands out most is how we achieved it.
body_markdown:
**By** **Whitney DiGiovanni, PMf Global CI Manager**


At the end of every quarter, teams across our organization work with a shared focus: delivering for customers and supporting one another. This quarter, that commitment was on full display.


We are proud to share that our Bedford, Massachusetts, team exceeded our Q3 revenue goals. While the result is exciting, what stands out most is how we achieved it.


This success was not the result of one team or department, or one initiative. It came from employees across the business[coming together to solve problems quickly](https://novanta.com/careers-culture/life-at-novanta/) and step outside their normal responsibilities to help wherever support was needed.


Throughout the quarter, our leadership team met daily to identify obstacles and remove barriers that could impact execution. Those conversations helped us stay aligned and respond quickly as priorities evolved.


What impressed us most was the willingness of people across the organization to do whatever was needed to support customers. Engineers spent time on production lines helping test and build products as customer Care teams proactively cleared line holds and identified opportunities to build orders early. Commercial and sales teams remained closely connected with customers, capturing opportunities and helping ensure we finished the quarter strong.


Operations teams demonstrated incredible dedication. Employees who do not typically work overtime stayed later to help ship products and purchasing teams worked closely with suppliers to secure materials and coordinate deliveries. Production leaders worked side by side with their teams on the manufacturing floor, finding creative solutions to maximize available resources and fulfill customer demand.


Even in the final hours of the quarter, teams continued to step up. Shipping teams remained focused on getting products out the door, while Finance worked quickly to resolve credit holds and minimize risks that could delay shipments.


What makes us proud is that this achievement reflects the culture we are building together. When challenges arose, people did not focus on organizational boundaries or job titles. They focused on helping one another succeed.


The quarter’s results demonstrate what is possible when talented teams unite around a common goal. More importantly, they show the impact we can have when collaboration and customer focus guide our actions every day.


Thank you to everyone who contributed. This accomplishment belongs to all of us
